decisions.decision: Ms. Seeley will coordinate agendas and minutes with the Chair.

decisions.decision: Minutes of July 7, June 18 and June 2 were approved and signed (no motion recorded); March 3 minutes require the signature of Mr. Mackin.
decisions.quote: minutes were approved and signed for meetings on july 7, june 18 and june 2.

decisions.decision: The Public Market plan will be placed on a future committee agenda once complete; Mr. Alison and the Agricultural Commission were suggested to prepare a business plan.
decisions.quote: mr. toale said the plan would be included in a future building re-use committee agenda when the plan is complete.

decisions.decision: The committee will take no action or further discussion on the T.C. Passios School and Brooks House until the School Committee and Planning Board determine their status; Mr. Erickson will give updates as liaison.
decisions.quote: the building re-use committee will take no action or have further discussion on these buildings until the status is determined by the school committee and planning board.

decisions.decision: The committee asked that two FY16 Capital Plan line items be requested: painting of the Town Hall facade (Mr. Toale to contact Mr. Rodiquenz for estimates) and funding for a Feasibility Study for Town Hall Renovation (Mr. MacDonald to prepare estimated cost).
decisions.quote: the committee asked that 2 line items be requested: 1. painting of the town hall building facade (mr. toale will contact mr. rodiquenz for estimates)

decisions.decision: Ms. Lantry will research Federal or State grant opportunities for the Town Hall renovation.
decisions.quote: ms. lantry will research grant opportunities.

decisions.decision: Committee meetings will remain on the 1st and 3rd Monday of the month at 6:30 p.m. at Town Hall or as needed; the next meeting is Monday, December 1st at 6:30 p.m.
decisions.quote: mr. toale said that the committee meetings would remain on the 1° and 35d monday of the month at 6:30 p.m at town hall or as needed.
